data.name: Mudgee
data.blurb: If you’re looking for wine and good times, escape to Mudgee with your girlfriends and embrace the town’s old-class charm and gourmet delights.

data.name: Gold Coast
data.blurb: One hour south of Brisbane, discover the magic of the Gold Coast’s glistening beaches, lush hinterland and idyllic seaside suburbs.

data.name: Hunter Valley
data.blurb: The centre of Hunter Valley wine country, scenic Pokolbin is a not-to-be-missed destination for ladies looking to do it all.

data.name: Noosa
data.blurb: With poolside cocktails and beachside banquets, Noosa is one of those dreamy getaway destinations not to be missed.

data.name: Byron Bay
data.blurb: Fall in love with the laid-back vibes of Australia’s favourite beach town. Byron Bay serves up sun, sand and serenity in spades.

data.name: Newcastle
data.blurb: The lively city of Newcastle, is a coastal treasure, featuring breathtaking beaches, a rich historical backdrop, and a wide array of exciting experiences for everyone to enjoy.

data.name: Port Stephens
data.blurb: A picturesque patch of coast just 2.5 hours drive north of Sydney, Port Stephens is an idyllic place for a weekend escape.

data.name: Brisbane
data.blurb: Riverside restaurants, rooftop bars, and glamorous accommodation await in Queensland’s sun-soaked capital of Brisbane.

data.name: Melbourne
data.blurb: Navigate your way through Melbourne’s vibrant laneways and city streets and you’ll find a mecca of all things trendy and tasty.

data.name: Mollymook
data.blurb: With endless ocean views and exceptional regional dining, Mollymook is a charming holiday destination that will delight all of your senses.

data.name: Sunshine Coast
data.blurb: With pristine beaches framed by rainforests and mountain peaks, Queensland’s Sunshine Coast is a slice of paradise just waiting to be explored.

data.name: Sydney
data.blurb: With glistening harbour views, beautiful beaches and an attractive bar and dining scene, a Sydney girls weekend will be one to remember.

data.name: Gerringong
data.blurb: The perfect combination of coast and country, an escape to Gerringong is the ideal getaway for ladies who relax best by the sea.

data.name: Great Ocean Road
data.blurb: When it comes to weekend road trips, little compares to the rugged beauty, beaches, and incredible landscapes along Victoria’s Great Ocean Road.

data.name: Bali
data.blurb: Luxuriate in Canggu Bali, sample the best of Bali, private villas, day spas, natural waterfalls and iconic beach clubs you will never want to leave.

data.name: Blue Mountains
data.blurb: Be enchanted by the beauty of the Blue Mountains, home to World Heritage-listed wilderness, endless vistas and quaint villages.

data.name: Central Coast
data.blurb: Escape the city crowds and immerse yourselves in the nature and beauty of the Central Coast, situated an hour north of Sydney.

data.name: Gerroa
data.blurb: The perfect combination of coast and country, an escape to Gerringong is the ideal getaway for ladies who relax best by the sea.

data.name: Jervis Bay
data.blurb: Famous for its white sand beaches and tranquil swimming and snorkeling spots, Jervis Bay on the NSW South Coast is a beach-lovers paradise.

data.name: Kiama
data.blurb: For pure coastal bliss escape to the seaside town of Kiama, where days are spent hanging by the ocean and exploring local treasures.

data.name: Mornington Peninsula
data.blurb: One hour south of Melbourne, the Mornington Peninsula is a haven of beautiful coastlines, boutique wineries, renowned restaurants, and natural hot springs.

data.name: Orange
data.blurb: Quickly becoming the next must-visit wine region, the pretty country town of Orange is perfect for a gourmet girls’ weekend.

data.name: Sydney Surrounds
data.blurb: With tranquil bays, cool cafes and luxe day spas, Sydney’s surrounds certainly hit the spot if you’re looking for a relaxed-yet-chic getaway.

data.name: Western Australia
data.blurb: Choose from some of the popular WA destinations, the coastal city of Fremantle & the unique Rottnest Island. Discover the Dunsborough & Margaret River Wine country, famous for beautiful wines and scenery.

data.name: Snowy Mountains
data.blurb: Home to Australia’s highest peak, the adventure wonderland is brimming with fun experiences, from thrilling downhill runs on pristine snow to music festivals, wine tasting, fascinating heritage

data.name: South Australia
data.blurb: From blue-water beaches to rolling vineyard hills, enjoy everything from wildlife to wine on a girls getaway in South Australia. Discover our range of getaways from the city to Adelaide Hills, Barossa, the beaches and beyond.
